name: notification-stack
title: Notification stack
description: Notifications folded into a neat pile that fans out into a list, each one dismissable.

props.name: items
props.description: The notifications, in order. The first one is the top card when the pile is folded.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called with the notification id when its dismiss button is pressed. Without it there are no dismiss buttons.

props.name: labels
props.description: Visible and screen reader text with English defaults. Keys: `title`, `show`, `hide`, `dismiss` and `empty`.

a11y.text: Show all and Show less is a native button, shown only with more than one item. Each Dismiss button is a native button. While the stack is folded only the first card has one.

The stack is a section labelled by labels.title, with an ordered list. A hidden status paragraph is always in the page and announces notifications that arrive after the first render (title and body). Each arrival writes a new text node, so two notifications with the same text are both read; dismissing one does not announce anything. The toggle sets aria-expanded and aria-controls. While folded, every card after the first is aria-hidden. Each dismiss button is named Dismiss: <title>, and the icons are aria-hidden.

The stack is wrapped in MotionConfig with reducedMotion set to user, so Motion follows the system setting for the fold and fan-out. The chevron turn and button colour transitions are off under reduced motion.
